title: Cash Hidden in Forests? Hungary Goes After Corruption Under Orban
summary_full: The new government says $20 million worth of bank notes uncovered in farmhouses and woods are the “tip of the iceberg.” Allies of Viktor Orban, the former prime minister, call it a witch hunt.
